name: language-julia-redux
description: Julia language support for Pulsar, using the tree-sitter-julia parser (modern Tree-sitter).

markdownInDocstrings.title: Highlight docstrings as Markdown
markdownInDocstrings.description: Docstrings are Markdown; with this on they are highlighted as such, and only their quotes are coloured as a string (requires the bundled language-gfm package). Takes effect for files opened afterwards.

juliaInDoctests.title: Highlight Julia in doctests and REPL examples
juliaInDoctests.description: In `jldoctest` and `julia-repl` code blocks (in docstrings and Markdown files), highlight the input after each `julia>` prompt as Julia, and mark the prompts. The output is left as it is. Takes effect for files opened afterwards.

docstringBackground.title: Docstring background
docstringBackground.description: Give the lines of docstrings a faint background, to set them apart from code.

docstringGuide.title: Docstring guide
docstringGuide.description: Draw a thin line down the left edge of docstrings.
